newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain Telecommunications lifts H1 97 net.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain Telecommunications lifts H1 97 net.

text.p: Bahrain Telecommunications Co (Batelco) made a 16.1 million dinar ($42.7 million) net profit in the first six months of 1997, the Gulf News Agency reported on Tuesday.
It quoted Batelco Chairman Sheikh Ali bin Khalifa al-Khalifa as saying net profit was 23 percent higher than in the year-ago period.
Batelco, 39 percent owned by the Bahraini government and 20 percent by Cable and Wireless Plc, said last year it made a net profit of 12.95 million dinars in the first half of 1996.

The company, which has one of the most advanced networks in the region, said last week it had signed a 4.5 million deal with Sweden's Ericsson to expand its Global System for Mobile Communications network to 80,000 lines from 35,000 now. -- Bahrain newsroom +973-524424
